title: the `.?` postfix operator is retired: use ordinary narrowing or optional chaining
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Absence': the earlier ?T, payload-capture, orelse, and .? grammar MUST NOT be part of the language, while ordinary optional chaining remains TypeScript behavior. The receiver is a T | undefined call, so the frontend must reject only the authored retired operator without claiming invalid map provenance or inventing an Optional container.
